performance_selection.selection_basis: User stopped batch tuning; revert to original stable batch 4 / powers. No further batch search.

review_selection.basis: Tune-only selection; no fresh quality predictions have been evaluated

review_calibration.formula: Only when raw choice is allow, use review if p(review)/(p(review)+p(allow)) >= threshold; keep every other raw action.
review_calibration.selection: tune only; benign intervention <=1%; maximize all-attempt accuracy, then fewer abuse allows and benign interventions, then higher threshold
review_calibration.note: Model-score postprocessing, distinct from unmodified Karpo argmax; no rule/oracle output substituted.

infrastructure.policy: Read-only verification; EC2 retained by user instruction

conclusion: 最终配置固定batch 4、CUDA Graph powers、原提示，增加复核分数阈值。实际HTTP服务的新留出集最终决策正确率98.43%（1063/1080）；同批请求的原始Karpo选择正确率为78.06%。两轮100 RPS性能未通过，计入失败的压力正确率未通过，整体未通过验收。
